predictedBugs: The new page could fail to render if ecossistema is absent from config.routes.validPages.
A typo in a static CTA route could send the SPA to its 404 page or a fallback document.
A navigation edit could disturb the existing authenticated user menu or mobile-collapse behavior.
edgeCases: At widths below 576px the ecosystem map and CTA actions must collapse to one column.
The #jornadas CTA must remain a same-page anchor so the SPA router allows native scrolling.
Unauthenticated and authenticated header states must continue to use the existing header action element.

step6_5.notes: The page has no new functions or API behavior. Static route strings were validated against config.routes.validPages; deterministic Node, HTTP, diff, and HTML-fragment checks were executed instead of a unit test suite.
